name: USW-Pro-24-POE
title: Switch Pro 24 PoE
summary: 1U L3 24x 1GbE PoE switch (16 PoE+, 8 PoE++), 2x 10G SFP+ uplinks, 400W budget.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (5.10.5+)

extra.ipv4_static_routes: spec says 2 (vs 256-512 on siblings) — likely data error

gotchas: All 24 access ports are 1GbE — 2.5GbE WiFi 7 APs (U7 Pro) are capped; USW-Pro-Max-24-PoE adds 2.5GbE PoE ports.
400W budget vs 16x30W + 8x60W = 960W theoretical — you can't max every port.
Older generation (2020-era, Network 5.10 baseline) superseded by the Pro Max line with Etherlighting and multi-gig.
Spec lists only 2 IPv4 static routes — treat its L3 as very limited.
best_for: 1G PoE closet with a few 60W devices
